title: RATIO: Reasoning Analysis and Token-level Inference Optimization for Quantized Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become a widely adopted technique for reducing the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs). However, recent studies reveal that when applied to reasoning models, PTQ not only degrades reasoning performance but also exacerbates overthinking, leading to longer reasoning trajectories. These issues may offset the efficiency gains expected from lower-precision inference. Existing approaches mainly rely on complex optimization procedures. More recent lightweight inference strategies instead use predefined overthinking markers, limiting their adaptability across quantized models. To address these issues, we propose Reasoning Analysis and Token-level Inference Optimization (RATIO), a framework that identifies model-specific overthinking tokens and assigns each a tailored penalty. translated_title: RATIO：面向量化推理模型的推理分析与词元级推理优化
translated_abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）已成为一种被广泛采用的技术，用于降低大语言模型（LLM）的内存占用和推理成本。然而，近期研究表明，当PTQ应用于推理模型时，不仅会降低推理性能，还会加剧过度思考（overthinking）现象，导致推理轨迹变得更长。这些问题可能抵消低精度推理本应带来的效率提升。现有方法主要依赖复杂的优化流程，而较新的轻量级推理策略则使用预定义的过度思考标记，限制了其在量化模型上的适应性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了推理分析与词元级推理优化框架（RATIO），该框架能够识别模型特定的过度思考词元，并为每个词元分配定制的惩罚。RATIO首先引入量化感知推理行为分析（QRBA）来识别过度思考……（摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RATIO框架，通过量化感知推理行为分析（QRBA）识别量化推理模型中模型特定的过度思考词元并为其分配定制惩罚，从而在不依赖复杂优化流程或预定义标记的情况下缓解量化带来的性能下降与过度思考问题。
en_tdlr: RATIO is a framework that identifies model-specific overthinking tokens in quantized reasoning models via Quantization-aware Reasoning Behavior Analysis (QRBA) and assigns each token a tailored penalty, mitigating PTQ-induced performance degradation and overthinking without relying on complex optimization or predefined markers.
